issues.current_text: A Waymo, com 500 mil corridas semanais, não conseguiu treinar robotáxis a parar para ônibus escolares em Austin — ao menos duas dúzias de infrações, mesmo após updates.
issues.previous_text: A Waymo atingiu 500 mil corridas pagas por semana em 10 cidades: 10x em dois anos com a mesma frota de ~3 mil veículos, pura otimização de software.
issues.suggestion: The Austin school-bus story is new and worth keeping, but drop the '500 mil corridas semanais' stat — it was the headline just yesterday. Open with the Austin incident directly: 'A Waymo não conseguiu treinar robotáxis a parar para ônibus escolares em Austin...'

issues.current_text: Na Europa, VW, Mercedes, Waymo e Pony.ai preparam lançamentos em Londres, Hamburgo e Zagreb, com ~120 mil robotáxis projetados até 2030.
issues.previous_text: Uber, Pony.ai e Verne anunciaram o primeiro robotáxi comercial da Europa em Zagreb, com veículos Arcfox equipados pelo sistema autônomo Gen-7 da Pony.ai
issues.suggestion: Zagreb was already covered as 'Europe's first commercial robotaxi' on 03/27. The broader European expansion (London, Hamburg, 120K projection) is new — rewrite to focus on the new cities and 2030 projection without re-mentioning Zagreb, or acknowledge it as an expansion of the Zagreb story.

issues.current_text: Em Islamabad, chanceleres de Paquistão, Turquia, Arábia Saudita e Egito tentam viabilizar um encontro Rubio-Araghchi; o Irã exige reparações e reconhecimento de sua posição no Estreito de Ormuz antes de diálogo direto
issues.previous_text: Em Islamabad, o Paquistão reuniu os chanceleres da Arábia Saudita, Turquia e Egito para coordenar a desescalada com o Irã — sem acordos formais, mas com uma possível reunião Rubio-Araghchi em dias.
issues.suggestion: Nearly identical setup — same city, same countries, same goal. The new detail is Iran's preconditions (reparations, Hormuz recognition) and Pezeshkian's quote. Reframe around what changed: 'As mediações em Islamabad avançam com novas exigências iranianas: reparações e reconhecimento de sua posição em Ormuz antes de diálogo direto com Washington.' Drop the repetitive list of countries or compress it.

issues.current_text: O Brent abriu acima de $115 — maior nível desde julho de 2022 —, WTI acumula alta de 40% desde fevereiro, e a probabilidade de o Fed subir juros em 2026 cruzou 50%.
issues.previous_text: com o Brent se mantendo acima de $100 após alta de 5% na sexta
issues.suggestion: Oil prices have been covered in all 4 editions ($108 on 03/27, $100 on 03/29, now $115). The $115 price and Fed hike probability are genuinely new data points, but frame them as continuation: 'O Brent ultrapassou $115 — terceira semana consecutiva de alta — e a probabilidade de o Fed subir juros cruzou 50%.' Acknowledge the trend rather than presenting each price point as a standalone revelation.

issues.current_text: A OpenAI encerrou o Sora e redirecionou GPU para o Codex — 2 milhões de MAUs, $200/mês, plano de fundir com ChatGPT e Atlas num 'super app'.
issues.previous_text: A OpenAI lançou plugins para o Codex integrando Slack, Figma e Notion ao assistente de 1,6 milhão de usuários semanais, com builds ilimitados
issues.suggestion: Codex was covered extensively on 03/28 (plugins, Slack/Figma/Notion integration, user count). The Sora shutdown is new and worth leading with. The MAU update (1.6M → 2M) is incremental. Consider: 'A OpenAI encerrou o Sora e redirecionou GPU para o Codex, que agora planeja fundir com ChatGPT e Atlas num super app.' Drop the MAU/price details already covered.

issues.current_text: A Amazon comprou a Fauna Robotics... Na China, a Agibot atingiu 10.000 humanoides produzidos... Foshan inaugurou a primeira linha automatizada de humanoides do país
issues.previous_text: Musk declarou que o Optimus Gen 3 inicia produção no verão de 2026... empresas chinesas lideradas pela Unitree controlam quase 90% dos embarques globais de humanoides de 2025
issues.suggestion: Humanoid robots have appeared in 3 consecutive editions (03/28: Agile-DeepMind+Boston Dynamics, 03/29: Optimus Gen 3 + Chinese dominance, 03/30: Amazon Fauna + Agibot + Foshan). The Amazon acquisition is genuinely new. The Chinese production stats reinforce a narrative already established yesterday. Consider cutting the Foshan factory detail and keeping only Amazon + Agibot's 10K milestone as the freshest items.

issues.current_text: A Mistral levantou $830M em sua primeira dívida
issues.previous_text: A suíça Kandou AI levantou $225M (03/29); Physical Intelligence negocia mais $1bi (03/28)
issues.suggestion: The '[Company] levantou $[X]M' construction has appeared in every recent edition. Vary the verb: 'A Mistral fechou $830M em dívida com sete bancos' or 'Sete bancos — BNP Paribas, HSBC, Bpifrance entre eles — financiaram $830M para a Mistral'.

issues.current_text: primeiro app agentic no AT Protocol (Bluesky/Attie), primeira linha automatizada de humanoides do país (Foshan), primeiro grande financiamento de dívida para infraestrutura de IA na Europa (Mistral)
issues.previous_text: primeiro chip próprio em 35 anos (Arm, 03/29), primeiro sistema de pesquisa autônoma a passar por revisão por pares (Sakana, 03/27), primeiro robotáxi comercial da Europa (Zagreb, 03/27)
issues.suggestion: Three 'primeiro' framings in the current draft, after two in 03/29 and two in 03/27. The word has lost its punch through overuse. Keep only the most consequential one (Mistral's debt financing is genuinely precedent-setting). For the others, find different angles: Attie can be described by what it does rather than its 'first' status; Foshan can lead with the production cadence (one robot every 30 minutes).

issues.current_text: Iran/Gulf conflict paragraph covering intercepted missiles, diplomatic mediation, oil prices, and Fed implications — all in one dense block
issues.previous_text: Similar dense Iran/Gulf paragraphs in 03/29 (Islamabad mediation + Brent + Trump deadline), 03/28 (Israel strikes Arak + Hormuz + Rubio G7 quote), 03/27 (Ormuz + houthis + oil shock + Goldman estimate)
issues.suggestion: The Iran-Gulf-oil paragraph has become a structural fixture with the same pattern: military action → diplomatic attempt → oil price → economic consequence. Every edition for 4 days. Readers will start skimming. For 03/30, lead with the genuinely new angle (UAE intercepted 16 ballistic missiles — the defensive side is fresh) and keep oil/Fed as a one-line coda. Or break the pattern by leading with the economic consequence ($115 Brent, Fed hike probability) and treating the military details as context.

issues.current_text: Separadamente, o WINREVAIR da Merck atingiu o endpoint primário
issues.previous_text: Separadamente, uma análise do Financial Times de John Burn-Murdoch
issues.suggestion: 'Separadamente' appeared yesterday in the same transitional role. Use 'Em paralelo', 'Noutra frente', or simply restructure the paragraph to avoid needing a transition word.

summary: Moderate repetition: 3 stories overlap significantly (Waymo 500K stat, Islamabad mediation, Codex), humanoid robots appear for the 3rd consecutive day, and the Iran-Gulf-oil paragraph has become a structural clone across all 4 editions. The 'primeiro' framing is overused.
